title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theatre, Univ. of California on 1982-05-22
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/48k) -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> -> Samplitude Professional v11.1 -> FLAC/16
source: (FOB) Nakamichi 700 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Dolby B/Maxell XLII-S90)

ai_review.summary: Top‑notch recording captures a smoking first set with Jerry and Phil firing on all cylinders
ai_review.review: The reviewer raves about the first set, calling it absolutely smoking and highlighting Jerry’s blazing guitar work and Phil’s powerful bass. The sound is described as top‑notch with loud, clear guitars (vocals a bit recessed), making this an outstanding early‑‘82 performance despite no comments on the second set.

ai_rating.rationale: Both the musical performance and recording quality are praised at the highest level, justifying a near‑perfect rating even though only one review is available.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Guitars are loud and clear; vocals slightly less prominent but overall top‑notch sound.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set described as a standout, high‑energy performance; no comments on second set.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Firing on all cylinders with blazing guitar work
band_member_comments.Phil: Also firing, delivering strong bass lines
